name: Landscape and weather observation
description: Authored landscape and weather observation directions that restyle the existing subject without inventing scene objects.
author: PromptStyler Next contributors

styles.name: Frontal-rain observation
styles.description: A landscape-photography treatment under a broad frontal-rain atmosphere. Flatten the distant illumination while preserving nearby form separation.

clauses.text: A landscape-photography treatment under a broad frontal-rain atmosphere
